title: Grilled Tempeh Schnitzel with Kenyan Spiced Sauerkraut
description: A German-inspired twist on traditional schnitzel, featuring tempeh in a decadent creamy breading, paired with a spicy Kenyan-infused sauerkraut.
instructions: 2. In a shallow dish, mix together flour, parmesan, and grill seasoning.
3. In a separate dish, mix together yogurt and Kenyan spice blend.
4. Dip each tempeh piece into the yogurt mixture, then coat in the flour mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
5. Grill the tempeh for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crispy.
6. Meanwhile, sauté onions in a pan until softened.
7. Add sauerkraut to the pan and cook until heated through.
8. Serve the grilled tempeh with the Kenyan spiced sauerkraut and sautéed onions.
9. Garnish with additional parmesan and breadcrumbs, if desired.
